title: The Veil and the Furnishings of the Sanctuary
description: God gives Moses instructions for the veil that is to separate the Holy Place from the Most Holy Place, with cherubim woven into it and hung on four overlaid acacia posts. Behind the veil, the ark of the testimony is to stand with the mercy seat above it. The table is placed on the north side and the lampstand on the south side outside the veil. For the entrance to the tent, a curtain made of embroidered work is also to be made, hung on five overlaid posts with bases of bronze.
